title: Oxagen theme request
description: The fields of theme/theme.json one change asks for. The theme editor writes a request into theme/requests/, and the apply-theme workflow merges it into theme/theme.json, fetches any Google face, and runs the generators. Every field is optional except summary. A face names the whole face of a role. The wordmark face is fixed, so faces has no wordmark.

summary.description: One line that says what the change is. It becomes the commit message.

requested_at.description: When the editor wrote the request, in UTC.

color.description: The palette. Primary text on ink is the paper colour, and primary text on paper is the ink colour.

gold.description: The primary brand colour. It fills the gold glyph of each wordmark, the hive's lit cells, Stella's asterisk, the primary button, and the focus ring. It must clear 4.5:1 on ink.

gold_bright.description: The gold's lighter neighbour, for hover on ink and the shimmer. The build sets it at this OKLCH lightness and chroma, on the gold's own hue rounded to a whole degree.

gold_deep.description: The gold's darker neighbour, for gold set as text on paper. The build derives it like gold_bright. It must clear 4.5:1 on paper, and the gold's lightness must sit between the two neighbours.

ink.description: The dark theme's surfaces, from the canvas up.

paper.description: The light theme's surfaces, from the canvas up.

text_on_ink.description: Text colours in the dark theme, below primary text. body and muted must clear 4.5:1 on ink.

muted.description: Secondary text. It must also clear 4.5:1 on a lifted row.

dim.description: The quietest text. Never a word that carries meaning.

text_on_paper.description: Text colours in the light theme, below primary text. body and muted must clear 4.5:1 on paper.

dim.description: The quietest text. Never a word that carries meaning.

muted_text_lightness.description: The OKLCH lightness of muted-text-ink: muted moved darker on its own hue and chroma, so secondary text also clears 4.5:1 on a lifted row.

states.description: The six governance states. Each has a mark on ink and a mark on paper: a badge, a dot, or a border, which needs 3:1. The build derives each state's text stop from its mark.

approval.description: A request routed to a person.

proven.description: The witness's word, beside a witness flip.

failed.description: A check that did not hold. The destructive red on paper is this mark.

critical.description: A run that needs a person now.

state_text_lightness_on_ink.description: The OKLCH lightness of every state's text stop on ink. A text stop keeps its mark's hue and chroma. On paper it keeps its mark's lightness too. Each text stop must clear 4.5:1 on every surface of its theme.

destructive_lift_on_ink.description: How far the destructive red on ink sits above the failed mark in OKLCH lightness, so it clears 4.5:1 as text on ink and under ink text.

radius.description: Corners. Every step of the scale is the base times its multiplier.

base.description: The corner every step multiplies, as --ox-radius-base. The kit's UI reads it as --ui-radius.

steps.description: The multiplier for each step of the scale, as --ox-radius-<step>. The kit's rounded-<step> classes read these.

card.description: The step a card and a panel take, as --ox-radius-card.

site.description: The website's corner for cards, panels, and inputs, as --ox-radius. The sites read it through house-tailwind.css as --radius. It does not follow the base yet. Phase 3 of oxageninc/brand#63 moves the sites onto --ox-radius-card and retires it.

shadow.description: Shadows, on ink and on paper. Each value is a CSS box-shadow. It may name a house colour as var(--ox-<token>).

ui.description: The quiet shadow under a control, as --ox-shadow-ui on ink and --ox-shadow-ui-ink on paper. Hairline borders do most of the work.

pop.description: The shadow under a floating surface: a menu, a popover, a dialog, or a toast. As --ox-shadow-pop on ink and --ox-shadow-pop-ink on paper.

unit.description: The spacing unit, as --ox-space. Tailwind's --spacing reads it, so p-4 is four units.

wrap.description: The widest a page's content runs, as --ox-wrap.

type.description: Weights, tracking, and the two type scales.

weights.description: The weight for each job, as --ox-weight-<job>. The wordmarks take faces.wordmark.outline.weight.

tracking.description: Letter spacing, as --ox-tracking-<name>. Headings track tighter as they grow.

scales.description: The two size scales. marketing is large and spaced, for a page read once. app is dense, for panels, tables, and logs read all day. No step is larger than the step above it, and every step on both scales is 14px (0.875rem) or more. build/theme.py refuses a smaller step.

marketing.description: The text-m-* utilities and the --ox-m-* sizes.

app.description: The text-a-* utilities and the --ox-a-* sizes.

faces.description: The roles whose face changes. Each names the whole face. The wordmark face is fixed: Space Grotesk, drawn at weight 600.

hex.description: A colour as six uppercase hex digits, such as #D4AF37.

chroma.description: An OKLCH chroma: 0 is grey, and the gold sits near 0.14.

hl.description: A row or line lifted off a panel, and the hover surface.
A row or line lifted off a panel, and the hover surface.

ink.description: The mark on ink. It must clear 3:1 on ink.

paper.description: The mark on paper. It must clear 3:1 on paper.

family.description: The family name the CSS asks for, as the font file names itself.

source.description: Where the files come from. kit means the files are already in fonts/. google means the apply workflow fetches the family from Google Fonts into fonts/ before the build runs.

file.description: A font file name in fonts/, with no directory.

files.description: The webfont files the CSS loads, one @font-face rule each.

weight.description: One weight, such as 400, or the range a variable file covers, such as 100 900.

style.description: The style the file draws. Leave it out for an upright file. An italic file is loaded as the same family with font-style: italic.

fallback.description: The families a browser tries when the face has not loaded, in order. End with a generic family such as sans-serif or monospace.

features.description: OpenType feature tags to turn on, such as calt and liga. Leave it empty for the face's defaults.

rem.description: A length in rem, such as 0.45rem. 1rem is 16px.

length.description: A length in rem or px, such as 1120px.

shadow.description: A CSS box-shadow, such as 0 1px 2px oklch(0.15 0 0 / 0.07), or none.

tracking.description: Letter spacing in em, such as -0.02em, or 0.

size.description: The font size. It must be a whole number of pixels, and 14px (0.875rem) or more.

leading.description: The line height, as a multiple of the size.

tracking.description: The name of a type.tracking value.

face_request.description: The whole face of one role. google fetches the family from Google Fonts at the weights given. upload reads files someone uploaded to fonts/ on the same branch. kit reads files already in fonts/.

weights.description: For google: the weights to fetch. The workflow fetches one variable file when the family has one.

files.description: For upload and kit: the files in fonts/, by name, with the weight each one draws. A .ttf, .otf, or .woff upload is converted to .woff2 for the web.

outline.description: For sans: the file the art's text is drawn from. When it is left out, the workflow picks the file closest to weight 400.
